hook: Last five United-Liverpool — and Kobbie Mainoo bookended them at eighteen and twenty.
narration: Last five United-Liverpool — and Kobbie Mainoo bookended them at eighteen and twenty. Number five. April 2024, Old Trafford, Premier League. Two-two. Bruno from the halfway line. Then Mainoo, eighteen years old, drilled one from twenty-five yards. Salah's late penalty levelled it — two apiece, nobody satisfied. Number four. September 2024, Old Trafford. Three-nil Liverpool. Diaz brace, Salah added the third. Slot won his first United meeting; ten Hag was sacked weeks later. Number three. January 2025, Anfield. Two-two. Martinez rocket, Salah penalty. Then Amad Diallo's eightieth-minute equaliser denied the league leaders. Amorim's first big point. Number two. October 2025, Anfield. United two, Liverpool one. Mbeumo inside two minutes. Gakpo equalised. Then Maguire — yes, Maguire — headed United's first Anfield win in nine years. Number one. May 2026, Old Trafford. Three-two. Cunha and Sesko inside fifteen. Liverpool clawed back through Szoboszlai and Gakpo. Then Mainoo again — seventy-seventh minute, twenty years old now. Champions League sealed. LIKE if you were there. COMMENT next rivalry to recap.
